Are your treats safe for puppies?
Yes! All our treats are formulated to be safe for puppies 8 weeks and older. Always supervise your pet when feeding.
Real chicken, sweet potatoes, peas, chickpeas, and a blend of natural vitamins and minerals. No artificial preservatives.

What if my pet doesn't like them?
We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If your pet doesn't love them, we'll refund your purchase — no questions asked.
Are these safe for cats too?
Our treats are formulated for both dogs and cats! They're soft enough for cats to enjoy too.
